SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
MONDAY - FEBRUARY 3, 2025 - 06:00 P.M.
CERRITOS SENIOR CENTER AT PAT NIXON PARK - MAJESTIC ROOM
12340 SOUTH STREET, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting in person in the Majestic Room at the Cerritos Senior Center at Pat Nixon Park.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 10:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 10:00 a.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD MONDAY,
FEBRUARY 3, 2025, 6:00 PM, IN THE MAJESTIC ROOM AT THE CERRITOS SENIOR CENTER
AT PAT NIXON PARK, 12340 SOUTH STREET, CERRITOS, CA 90703.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 6:00 p.m.

 2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo.

 3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Councilmember Bruce W. Barrows
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo

  Councilmembers Lynda P. Johnson and Frank Aurelio Yokoyama, and Mayor Naresh
  Solanki were noted absent for the record.

  Due to lack of a quorum, none of the items listed below were considered. The
  meeting was adjourned at this juncture.

 4.  New and Old Business

 4A.  Review and consideration of ratification of the City Manager’s regulation to continue
  the proclamation of the existence of a local emergency concerning a gasoline leak from
  a privately owned existing pipeline on the Cerritos Iron-Wood Nine public golf course,
  and potential threat to the safety of persons and property requiring remediation,
  repair, and improvement of the public golf course and other City-owned public
  property, as specified (COUNCIL).

 4B.  Review and consideration of a study session of the Cerritos City Council reviewing
  proposed amendments to the City Council Protocol Manual (COUNCIL).

 5.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 6:01 p.m.
